debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d t-h-e i-n-i-t-i-a-l v-i-c-t-i-m p-r-o-f-i-l-e u-s-i-n-g s-t-o-l-e-n p-h-o-t-o-s a-n-d a n-o-n-y-m-o-u-s e-m-a-i l a-c-c-o-u-n-t s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d i-d e-n-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o n c-h-e-c k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r l-o-n-g s-t-o-r-a-g-e-d t-h-e c-h-a-t l-o-g s t-o b-u-i-l d t-r-u-s t o-v-e-r m-o-n-t-h s, l-e-f-t a f-t-e-r t-h-e s-e-r-v-e-r s y-s-t-e m l-o-g s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-u-d-i t t-r-a-i l o-f m-e-s-s-a-g-e t-i-m-e s t-a-m-p s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d f-a-k-e e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y b-a-n-k t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-q-u-e-s-t s w-i-t-h a-n-i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l a-c-c-o-u-n-t d-e-t-a-i-l s, l-e-f-t a c-c-o-u-n t n-u-m-b-e r r-e-c-o-r-d s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-u-a l r-e-v-i-e-w f-o-r i-m-p-o-s-s-i-b-l e w-i-r-e a-m-o-u-n-t s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d t-h-r-e-e t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-y m-u-l-e s v-i-a o-f-f-s-i-t-e m-e-s-s-e-n-g-e-r s, l-e-f-t d-e-p-o-s-i-t s-l-i-p s c-o-p-i-e-s a-n-d c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-d v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o n f-o-r e-a-c-h n-e-w r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-e.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d g-h-o-s-t a-c-c-o-u-n-t s t-o m-u-t-e v-i-c-t-i-m i-n-t-e-r-a-c-t-i-o-n s a-n-d b-l-o-c-k s h-a-r-e-d g-r-o-u-p c-h-a-t s, l-e-f-t s-e-r-v-e r i-p a-d-d-r-e-s s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e n-e-t-w-o-r-k t-h-r-e-a-d i-a n-a-l-y-s-i-s f-o-r a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y p-a-t-t-e-r-n s.
